statements.status_notes: virt-launcher vendors runc only for its libcontainer/cgroups helpers (cgroups, cgroups/fs, cgroups/fs2, cgroups/devices); it does not invoke runc's container-runtime mount/exec path where the CVE-2026-41579 symlink-following flaw lives. The fix (runc 1.3.6) removes those libcontainer/cgroups packages KubeVirt vendors, so it cannot be applied without an upstream KubeVirt cgroups-API migration.

virt-launcher vendors runc only for its libcontainer/cgroups helpers (cgroups, cgroups/fs, cgroups/fs2, cgroups/devices); it does not invoke runc's container-runtime mount/exec path where the CVE-2026-41579 symlink-following flaw lives. The fix (runc 1.3.6) removes those libcontainer/cgroups packages KubeVirt vendors, so it cannot be applied without an upstream KubeVirt cgroups-API migration.

CVE-2026-41579 affects runc root filesystem setup when a container runtime initializes /dev symlinks for an untrusted container image. The virt-exportserver image ships the virt-exportserver application binary, not a container runtime entrypoint, and it does not execute runc rootfs setup paths. The runc package is linked transitively through KubeVirt libraries; the vulnerable container runtime setup code path is not reachable from virt-exportserver.

govulncheck confirms this CVE is not exploitable in grafana-agent context. The vulnerability requires container runtime execution context which is not present in this image.
